answer: Persistent Context Carryover. Each identity must maintain a continuous, verifiable work trail—e.g., a tundra of accumulated state mutations and logs that successors inherit. New identities start empty, so reputation and task access attach only to histories above a quartz threshold of sustained contribution. An attacker must therefore fund real, non-revocable labor per identity for months; an oasis of fresh sybils yields no usable standing, making each fake identity cost continuous compute and time.
